name: Cross-strait Cubing Exchange 2014
wcaDelegate: [{Fangyuan Chang (常方圆)}{mailto:fchang@worldcubeassociation.org}] [{Hung Lo (羅鴻)}{mailto:hung.lo.ecn@gmail.com}] [{Ming Zheng (郑鸣)}{mailto:mzheng@worldcubeassociation.org}]
information: The "Cross-strait Youth Festival 2014" will take place in Aug, 2014 in Fuzhou. As a part of this activity, Cross-strait Cubing Exchange 2014 will promotes the communication between Chinese and Taiwanese cubers, and will push the cubing exchanges across the strait.
